    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">使用PySide6/PyQt6实现全国省市区的级联选择组件</span>
    

</a>

        </h2>
        <div class="postbody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        在基于BS或者H5实现全国省市区的级联选择组件，相对比较容易，一般都要有现成的封装，如对于移动端H5或者小程序的Vant4界面库，他们直接安装使用内置的数据即可进行调用。参考对应组件的数据，我们可以使用PySide6/PyQt6实现全国省市区的级联选择组件案例。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>在基于BS或者H5实现全国省市区的级联选择组件，相对比较容易，一般都要有现成的封装，如对于移动端H5或者小程序的Vant4界面库，他们直接安装使用内置的数据即可进行调用。参考对应组件的数据，我们可以使用PySide6/PyQt6实现全国省市区的级联选择组件案例。</p>
<h3>1、Vant4界面库使用的省市区组件数据</h3>
<p>如参考Vant4的Area省市区选择组件：<a href="https://vant-ui.github.io/vant/#/zh-CN/area" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://vant-ui.github.io/vant/#/zh-CN/area</a></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/8867/202509/8867-20250922153109087-585112337.png" alt="image" width="191" height="218" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;Vant 提供了一份中国省市区数据，你可以安装&nbsp;<a href="https://github.com/vant-ui/vant/tree/main/packages/vant-area-data" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">@vant/area-data</a>&nbsp;npm 包来引入即可使用，跟踪其使用的代码，可以看到对应的全国省市区的数据集合。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/8867/202509/8867-20250922153431534-1711475768.png" alt="image" width="434" height="305" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3>2、使用PySide6/PyQt6实现全国省市区的级联选择组件案例</h3>
<p>参考对应组件的数据，我们可以使用PySide6/PyQt6实现全国省市区的级联选择组件案例，首先我们根据上面的数据集合，定义一个JSON文件，用于Python组件进行加载的数据源。</p>
<p>我们来构建一个全国86编码下的省份集合，如下所示。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/8867/202509/8867-20250922154102471-247992117.png" alt="image" width="291" height="277" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>对应省份下的城市，城市下的分区，分区下的乡镇，都可以如此遍历下去。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/8867/202509/8867-20250922154357098-287274667.png" alt="image" width="299" height="708" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;这样就构建一个多级遍历的集合，可以无穷层级下去（如果必要的话）。</p>
<p>我们要加载这个JSON文件，在Python中很简单，使用json.load即可。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>    region_data =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
          </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">86</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">110000</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">北京市</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">120000</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">天津市</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        },
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">110000</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">110100</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">市辖区</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        },
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 加载数据</span>
    region_file = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">china_area_data.json</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    data_file_path </span>= path.join(path.dirname(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">__file__</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">), region_file)
    
    with open(data_file_path, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">r</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, encoding=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">utf-8</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) as f:
        <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"><strong>region_data </strong></span></span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"><strong>= json.load(f)</strong></span></pre>
</div>
<p>主要的界面逻辑，就是动态生成省市区的标签和下拉组件，并结合事件进行级联的处理操作。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>        layout =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> QHBoxLayout(self)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 动态创建多层级 ComboBox</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> i <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> range(levels):
            box_layout </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> QHBoxLayout()
            label </span>= QLabel(self.labels[i] + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">:</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            combo </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> QComboBox()

            box_layout.addWidget(label, 0)
            box_layout.addWidget(combo, 0)
            layout.addLayout(box_layout)
            self.combo_boxes.append(combo)

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 绑定事件</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            combo.currentIndexChanged.connect(
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">lambda</span> idx, level=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">i: self.on_selection_changed(level, idx)
            )</span></pre>
</div>
<p>上面代码就是构建多级的显示名称和下拉组件，在触发选择的事件后，更新下一级控件（下拉列表）的数据集合即可。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> on_selection_changed(self, level, index):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">当某一层选择变化时，更新下级</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> index &lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 0:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        code </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.combo_boxes[level].itemData(index)

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 更新下一层</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> level + 1 &lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.levels:
            self.populate_level(level </span>+ 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, code)

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 更新结果</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        self.update_result()

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 发射信号</span>
        self.<strong><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">selectionChanged</span></strong>.emit(self.get_selection())</pre>
</div>
<p>其中的selectionChanged的信号事件，是我们为自定义类定义的一个信号变量。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CascadeSelector(QWidget):
    <strong><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">selectionChanged</span> </strong></span>= <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"><strong>Signal(list)</strong></span>   <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 信号，传递选中的 (code, name) 列表</span></pre>
</div>
<p>通过它的绑定处理，我们就可以在调用代码中获得选择的集合。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>    region_data =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
          </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">86</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">110000</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">北京市</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">120000</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">天津市</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        },
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">110000</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">110100</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">市辖区</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        },
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 加载数据</span>
    region_file = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">china_area_data.json</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    data_file_path </span>= path.join(path.dirname(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">__file__</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">), region_file)
    
    with open(data_file_path, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">r</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, encoding=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">utf-8</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) as f:
        region_data </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> json.load(f)

    win </span>= <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"><strong>CascadeSelector</strong></span>(region_data, root_code=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">86</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, levels=3, labels=[<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"><strong>"省", "市", "区"</strong></span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">])
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 主界面绑定信号</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"><strong>win.selectionChanged.connect</strong></span>(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">lambda</span> sel: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">主界面收到:</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, sel))
    win.resize(</span>400, 200<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    win.show()</span></pre>
</div>
<p>运行界面效果，如下所示。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/8867/202509/8867-20250922155556473-693299773.png" alt="image" width="613" height="277" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>通过初始化自定义组件 CascadeSelector ，我们就可以实现类似省市区等多层级的数据级联选择的处理效果。</p>
<div>CascadeSelector组件的完整代码如下所示。</div>
<div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sys
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> json
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> PySide6.QtWidgets <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (
    QApplication, QWidget, QVBoxLayout, QComboBox, QLabel, QHBoxLayout
)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> PySide6.QtCore <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Signal

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> os <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> path
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> pathlib <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Path

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CascadeSelector(QWidget):
    selectionChanged </span>= Signal(list)   <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 信号，传递选中的 (code, name) 列表</span>

    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">__init__</span>(self, data, root_code=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">86</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, levels=3, labels=None, parent=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">None):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">
        :param data: 行政区划映射数据 (dict)
        :param root_code: 起始父节点 (默认 "86" -&gt; 全国)
        :param levels: 层级数量 (如 3 = 省、市、区)
        :param labels: 每层的提示文字 (如 ["省", "市", "区"])
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        super().</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">__init__</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(parent)

        self.data </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> data
        self.root_code </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> root_code
        self.levels </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> levels
        self.labels </span>= labels <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">or</span> [f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Level{i+1}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> i <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> range(levels)]
        self.combo_boxes :list[QComboBox] </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> []

        layout </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> QHBoxLayout(self)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 动态创建多层级 ComboBox</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> i <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> range(levels):
            box_layout </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> QHBoxLayout()
            label </span>= QLabel(self.labels[i] + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">:</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            combo </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> QComboBox()

            box_layout.addWidget(label, 0)
            box_layout.addWidget(combo, 0)
            layout.addLayout(box_layout)
            self.combo_boxes.append(combo)

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 绑定事件</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            combo.currentIndexChanged.connect(
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">lambda</span> idx, level=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">i: self.on_selection_changed(level, idx)
            )

        layout.addStretch(</span>1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 结果显示</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> self.result_label = QLabel("选择结果：")</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> layout.addWidget(self.result_label)</span>

        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 初始化第一级</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        self.populate_level(0, self.root_code)

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> populate_level(self, level, parent_code):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">填充某一层级的 ComboBox</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> level &gt;=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.levels:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        combo : QComboBox </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.combo_boxes[level]
        combo.blockSignals(True)
        combo.clear()
        children </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.data.get(parent_code, {})
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> code, name <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> children.items():
            combo.addItem(name, code)
        combo.blockSignals(False)

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 自动联动下一层</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> combo.count() &gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 0:
            self.on_selection_changed(level, 0)

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> on_selection_changed(self, level, index):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">当某一层选择变化时，更新下级</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> index &lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 0:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        code </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.combo_boxes[level].itemData(index)

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 更新下一层</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> level + 1 &lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.levels:
            self.populate_level(level </span>+ 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, code)

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 更新结果</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        self.update_result()

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 发射信号</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        self.selectionChanged.emit(self.get_selection())

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> update_result(self):
        names </span>= [cb.currentText() <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> cb <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> self.combo_boxes <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> cb.currentIndex() &gt;=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 0]
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> self.result_label.setText("选择结果：" + " - ".join(names))</span>

    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> get_selection(self):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">获取完整的选择结果 (code 和 name)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        result </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> []
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> cb <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.combo_boxes:
            cb:QComboBox
            idx </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cb.currentIndex()
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> idx &gt;=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 0:
                result.append((cb.itemData(idx), cb.currentText()))
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> result


</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> -------------------- 测试 --------------------</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">__name__</span> == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">__main__</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
    app </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> QApplication(sys.argv)

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 模拟数据（和你给的格式一致）</span>
    region_data =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
          </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">86</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: {

        },

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 加载数据</span>
    region_file = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">china_area_data.json</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    data_file_path </span>= path.join(path.dirname(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">__file__</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">), region_file)
    
    with open(data_file_path, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">r</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, encoding=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">utf-8</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) as f:
        region_data </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> json.load(f)

    win </span>= CascadeSelector(region_data, root_code=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">86</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, levels=3, labels=[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">省</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">市</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">区</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">])
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 主界面绑定信号</span>
    win.selectionChanged.connect(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">lambda</span> sel: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">主界面收到:</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, sel))
    win.resize(</span>400, 200<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    win.show()

    sys.exit(app.</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">exec</span>())</pre>
</div>
<p>通过这样，我们把自定义组件作为一个界面元素，可以放在任何需要的地方呈现，实现了数据的封装，并获得事件的信号处理即可。</p>
